name: QA gate coverage for the platform repo (api/ + client/) — currently ungated if decision C is taken
description:
## Why this card exists

QA finding raised on `b776e9a7` (Decide QA gate root: open platform root (A) or register docs/ as sub-project (C)).

The QA gate of this project resolves its root to `.../codx-junior-platform/docs`, while the actual code under change lives in `.../codx-junior-platform/api/` and `.../codx-junior-platform/client/`. Measured on 2026-11-18 against the same working tree:

| Command | changed_files | unmapped_sources |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `qa_plan()` (gate root) | 59 | 27 |
| `qa_review_changes(scope="staged")` (gate root) | 18 | 7 |
| `qa_review_changes(paths=["docs"])` | 8 | 0 |

So the gate sees the platform code but this project owns no suite for it. If option **C** (register `docs/` as its own sub-project with a docs-only suite) is chosen, the platform repo loses its only candidate gate unless this card is executed in the same move. Otherwise the backend ships **ungated**: no test command, no mapping, no coverage.

## What to do

1. Decide and implement the gating for `api/` + `client/` — either keep the gate at the platform root and declare a pytest suite there (`qa_policy.suites` in the platform project config), or create the platform project with its own suite and point the autonomy/QA tools at it.
2. Note the known precondition from `e684ce5c`: the `qa_policy` key does not exist in `docs/.codx/project.json` and the schema is unverified (the `codx-api` atlas times out on every search). Do not assume `suites` is accepted — prove it.
3. Note the mapping defect from `3fb379ae`: the gate reported `test_files: 0` on a staged tree that does contain `api/api/tests/test_admin_bootstrap.py` (doubled `api/` prefix). A suite that collects 0 tests is the same finding as no suite.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `qa_plan()` at the chosen root returns `suites:` at least one entry and `default_suite:` not `none`.
- [ ] `qa_run_tests("auto")` returns `decision: allow` or a real test result (not `[high] tests.no-suite`).
- [ ] `qa_run_tests` proof output quoted: tests run / passed / failed counts.
- [ ] `qa_review_changes(scope="all")` on the platform root lists the changed api/ files as **mapped**, and `test_files` > 0.
- [ ] `qa_coverage()` returns a real percentage, not `[low] coverage.unavailable`.
- [ ] No product test was skipped or `xfail`-ed to reach these numbers.

## Command that proves it

`qa_run_tests(suite="auto")` and `qa_review_changes(scope="all", run_tests=True)` — both quoted in the card before it is marked done.

## Owner

`software_developer` (implementation + config). QA only re-verifies.

## Premise correction — the api repo is NOT empty of tests

This card was created on the assumption that `api/` would ship **ungated**. The test material is larger than I assumed; the gap is narrower and now precisely located.

### Measured this shift (`project_locate(project="codx-api")`)
`codx-api` is already a **registered, indexed project** with root `…/codx-junior-platform/api` (relation: dependency, indexed, fresh at `1af62f8cddd9 +dirty`). It contains at least 8 indexed test files:

| Path (relative to api root) | Note |
| --- | --- |
| `tests/security/test_secrets_vault.py` | imported by 14 files |
| `tests/browser/test_cdp_proxy_supervisor.py` | imported by 7 |
| `tests/browser/test_browser_keepalive.py` | imported by 1 |
| `tests/chat/test_chat_tool_memory.py` | — |
| `tests/quality/test_qa.py` | tests of the QA subsystem |
| `tests/quality/qa_selfcheck.py` | runnable on a bare interpreter |
| `tests/security/ciso_selfcheck.py` | smoke check, no pytest needed |

So **"there is nothing to run" is false for the api repo.** What is missing is a *declaration* (`qa_policy.suites`) and the right root — not tests.

### Two consequences for this card
1. **The suite to declare exists and has a natural shape:** from the api root, `pytest tests`. That is the candidate command; the acceptance criterion is that `qa_run_tests` returns **real counters with `total > 0`**, not `tests.no-suite`.
2. **Option C now has a working precedent inside this very repo:** `codx-api` already demonstrates a per-repo project registration with its own root and index. Registering `docs/` as a sub-project is therefore not a novel mechanism — it is the pattern already in use.

### Sharpened acceptance
- [ ] `qa_plan()` from the project that owns `api/` returns a **non-empty `suites`** list.
- [ ] `qa_run_tests` returns `total > 0` (quote the counter), not `[high] tests.no-suite`.
- [ ] `qa_review_changes(scope="all")` reports `test_files > 0` and maps `api/**` sources to tests.
- [ ] Fixed first, or the count stays 0: `test_admin_bootstrap.py` sits at `api/api/tests/` while every other test is at `api/tests/` — see the correction on `3fb379ae`.

Owner: `software_developer`. QA only re-verifies with the four commands above.

## PM shift 2026-11-18 08:44 UTC — this is a decision, not a task

Reprioritised to reflect what it actually is: a **management decision (D3)** that carries a real release risk, not a work item someone can pick up.

**The question, in one line:** with `docs/` as the project root (decision C, taken 2026-11-18), changes under `api/` and `client/` in `codx-junior-platform` are covered by **no** automated gate — 45 files, 11 `change.missing-tests` findings, 16 unmapped sources, and the suite that would judge them cannot run.

**Options**
| | Option | Cost | Consequence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | Open `codx-junior-platform` as its own project, with `python -m pytest api/tests` + coverage declared | 0.5d setup, 0 new tooling | api/client get a real gate; this docs project stays as it is |
| B | Accept ungated api/client changes; gate only the docs build | 0 | every backend change is merged on review alone — the risk is accepted in writing, by management |
| C | Defer; keep the docs-only suite | 0 now | same as B, but nobody has decided it, so nobody owns the next incident |

**Recommendation: A**, decided by 2026-11-21. It is the only option where a red gate still means something for the code that actually ships. B is defensible for a short while, but it must be an explicit, dated acceptance — silence is not an option.

**Not the same card as:**
- `3fb379ae` / `e684ce5c` — does the *docs* suite run at all (blocked on one human action).
- `a8be6182` — the verdict on one specific 45-file change (needs approval by 2026-11-19).

**Board changes:** `todo` → `onhold`, wake moved to **2026-11-20 10:00Z** (before the 2026-11-21 due date), added to sprint `QA gate hardening (18-21 Nov 2026)` as M3.

**PM note — this card carries a management DECISION, not developer work. Read before the 20 Nov 10:00 wake.**

I set `assignees` = `ProjectManager`, but the tool **refused to replace the `profiles` list** on update (`changed_fields: ["assignees"]`), so the card is still driven by `software_developer`. That is the wrong owner for the *decision* half of this card, so it is stated here explicitly:

- **The gate model is management's call, not the implementing developer's.** Option A vs B vs C changes who is accountable for an ungated backend. A developer must not pick it to unblock their own ticket.
- **At the wake, do NOT select an option.** Record the state, restate the three options with their cost, and leave the card `onhold` in *User action needed* until a human answers. If the answer arrives, implementation stays with `software_developer`.

Options, unchanged and still recommended as in the parent message: **A** (open the platform root, gate `api/`+`client/`) = recommended; **B** (accept ungated, dated in writing); **C** (defer, same as B but unowned). **Decide by 2026-11-21** — the sprint closes that day and the demo `f6d1855e` carries question 3.

If no answer by then: present it in the demo as an open decision with the recommended date displaced, **not** as work in progress. Silence is not an approval.

## Concrete evidence for this card — the ungated repo already has an active change (2026-11-19)

Not an abstract coverage argument. Today's instance, quoted from the QA gate on the platform repo:

- **45 changed files**, **11 findings — all `change.missing-tests`**, **0 test files**, **16 unmapped source files**, highest severity `medium`, decision **`require_approval`** (verbatim from `a8be6182`).
- Changed surface: `api/codx/junior/{ai/smol/effort.py, efforts/*, atlas/related.py, model/effort.py}` + 18 `client/src` files.
- `qa_run_tests(suite="auto")` → **block [high] `tests.no-suite`**.

And the part that matters most for sequencing: **nobody in this workspace can inspect that diff.** `read_folder("…/codx-junior-platform/api")` is refused — *"not within project root '…/docs'"* — and `project_locate(project="codx-api")` times out at **120s**. The gate's verdict can therefore only be trusted, never reproduced.

### Consequence for decision C
If C is ratified, this 45-file change is "reviewed" by a gate whose output no human here can verify, over a surface where 16 of 45 files have no test naming them. That is the status quo this card exists to end.

### Acceptance — keep it behavioural
Do **not** close this card on a config line or a `qa_policy` declaration. Closing requires a running suite over `api/` + `client/` that names the changed sources, and a gate run whose output a human can reproduce end to end. Until then, report the platform repo as **ungated** — not "gate declared".
